basis: FAM-BLAZER-INTEGRATE-005: host-free template for scripts/host-reconcile.py on a blazer tree. scripts/blazer_integration.py admits an already-signed bundle (no keys), then renders the operator's own --config from this template, the admitted inputs and the operator's host paths; nothing here names a host. The trusted patcher reads patches and overlays from candidate C's os/ bundle, so C must carry the Launcher3 and Updater release-discovery changes (checked at admission). Control policy is Frankel's shipped one: the signed controller as sole prototype agent, locked sessions off. The Updater route is REQUIRED and has no default: no blazer feed exists, Frankel's releases/latest names Frankel and Rango's feed is Rango's, so admission refuses until the release owner supplies a blazer route.

updaterRoute.missingInput: --updater-route ROUTE.json from the release owner: device blazer, updaterUrl https://github.com/OWNER/REPO/releases/download/, releaseIndex https://api.github.com/repos/OWNER/REPO/releases, publishedChannel stable, the blazer producer contract (tag blazer-{build}, assets blazer-stable and blazer-ota_update-{build}.zip, metadata line '{build} {buildDateUtc} blazer stable'), owner and approvalRef
updaterRoute.basis: Device-qualified release discovery (RoseReleases) is the only route form admitted: each check resolves one blazer-N release. A releases/latest URL is refused because Latest names Frankel.
